# BAD-009 — Run the smoke walkthrough on CI against the committed fixture library

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 40 (added 2026-08-18), still open as of 2026-09-14: no workflow under .github/workflows runs npm run smoke, so no CI job has ever booted the app. The main-process boot path, the pack:// handler, view switching and the whole renderer have no automated coverage.

The blocker is gone: fixtures/library/ is a committed, synthetic layout-2 library (npm run fixtures regenerates it), and CLAUDE.md documents the recipe, BT_LIBRARY_ROOT pointed at a copy of it (cp -R fixtures/library to a temp dir), never the committed tree, because the home leg installs a zip into the library it is given.

Fix direction: a smoke job in ci.yml starting at SMOKE_SCOPE=home (cheapest leg, catches boot regressions), widening leg by leg once it is reliable. It needs a display: xvfb-run on ubuntu-latest, or the windows-latest runner already in use. Smoke exits non-zero on SMOKE_FAIL, so the step can trust the status code; upload SMOKE_DIR screenshots as an artifact on failure.

Watch for: the reel leg needed the window frontmost. PR #328 ("Stop the smoke run from stealing focus") runs smoke hidden, but it is still open as of 2026-09-14, so land or check it before widening to the reel leg. ffmpeg is needed for the screening leg's transcode on a Linux runner.

Verification: the job green on the PR, plus one deliberately broken run showing it fails.
